_comment: Golden V4A envelopes for the Hermes patch tool. The first 20 rows are copied (one row differs on purpose, see its name) from internal/adapter/codex/testdata/patches.json (commit b084d95cf79af695cbb08d3c91f027ba50f096bf, copied at cee8a4c963ce152a24e8da7b38cb289fa1b21ecc); the rows after 'hermes dialect' are Hermes-specific. 'want' mirrors patchSummary; 'malformed' means parsePatch returns an error alongside the partial summary.

rows.name: single update
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
@@
-x
+y
*** End Patch

rows.name: update add delete
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
@@ func f()
 context
-old1
-old2
+new1
@@
-old3
+new2
*** Add File: b.go
+line1
+line2
*** Delete File: c.go
*** End Patch

rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: old/name.go
*** Move to: new/name.go
@@
-a
+b
*** End Patch
